definitions.explanation: the first fiscal or academic year of a project, policy, program, or similar undertaking

examples.japanese: {初年度|しょねんど}の{売上|うりあげ}は{好調|こうちょう}だった。
この{制度|せいど}は{初年度|しょねんど}から{成果|せいか}を{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: This system produced results from its first year.

examples.japanese: {初年度|しょねんど}の{目標|もくひょう}は{会員|かいいん}{一万人|いちまんにん}だ。
{大学|だいがく}{入学|にゅうがく}の{初年度|しょねんど}にかかる{費用|ひよう}は{約|やく}{百五十万円|ひゃくごじゅうまんえん}だ。
examples.english: The costs incurred in the first year of university enrollment are about 1.5 million yen.

notes:
A compound noun used in formal and business contexts to mark the first year of something — whether a fiscal year, a new policy, a product launch, or university enrollment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初年度|しょねんど}の{売上|うりあげ}: first-year sales
- {初年度|しょねんど}の{費用|ひよう}: first-year costs
- {初年度|しょねんど}{予算|よさん}: first-year budget
- {初年度|しょねんど}{目標|もくひょう}: first-year target

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一年目|いちねんめ}: the first year (ordinal); more general and conversational, while {初年度|しょねんど} is used in formal planning and reporting
- {年度|ねんど}: fiscal/academic year; the base word without the "first" qualifier
- {元年|がんねん}: first year of an era; used for reign names and metaphorically for epoch-making firsts

WORD FORMATION:
{初|しょ} (first, initial) + {年度|ねんど} (fiscal/academic year).
